value.description: The current value of the meter.

valueAsString.description: The current value of the meter as a formatted string.

setValue.description: Sets the current value of the meter.

setToMax.description: Sets the current value of the meter to the max value.

setToMin.description: Sets the current value of the meter to the min value.

percent.description: The percentage of the meter's value (0–100).

percentAsString.description: The percentage of the meter's value as a formatted string.

min.description: The minimum allowed value of the meter.

max.description: The maximum allowed value of the meter.

valueState.description: How good the current value is: `optimal`, `suboptimal`, or `least-optimal`.

ids.description:
The ids of the elements in the meter. Useful when the label lives outside
the machine and you need to control `aria-labelledby`.

value.description: The controlled value of the meter.

defaultValue.description:
The initial value of the meter when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the meter.

min.description: The minimum allowed value of the meter.

max.description: The maximum allowed value of the meter.

low.description:
The upper numeric bound of the low end of the measured range.
Defaults to `min`.

high.description:
The lower numeric bound of the high end of the measured range.
Defaults to `max`.

optimum.description:
The optimal numeric value. Combined with `low` and `high`, this decides
which region is preferred (HTML `<meter>` algorithm).
Defaults to the midpoint of `min` and `max`.

onValueChange.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

formatOptions.description: The options to use for formatting the value.

locale.description: The locale to use for formatting the value.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.
